name: Ad Inserter – Ad Manager
description: Ad Inserter – Ad Manager: a content-entity-based ad manager that stores HTML/JavaScript ad snippets and renders them site-wide via blocks, with mobile/desktop screen targeting.
project_description: Ad Inserter (Ad Manager) is a small ad-management tool built around a single content entity type (ad_inserter). Each entity holds a name, an optional machine name, a body field into which an administrator pastes raw HTML or ad-network JavaScript, and a screen target (all/mobile/desktop). Ads are placed on the site with one of two block plugins — select an ad by entity reference, or reference it by machine name — and mobile/desktop targeting is applied client-side against a configurable breakpoint. Requires the core field module.
